title: Raytolfas AutoSpam
description: Raytolfas AutoSpam is a Minecraft 1.16.5 plugin that automates chat message spamming at set intervals.
body:
# **Raytolfas AutoSpam development has been discontinued.**

## Raytolfas AutoSpam
is a Minecraft plugin designed to automate the process of sending messages in the chat at predefined intervals. This plugin is ideal for server admins looking to spam messages or promotions in the chat without manual input. It can be easily configured through a simple configuration file, where you can set the message content and the time intervals for automatic posting.

# Features:

Automated message spamming at customizable intervals.
Easy configuration through a simple config file.
Support for any message content, including text, links, or promotional materials.
Compatible with Minecraft version 1.16.5.
Lightweight and easy to install.
